written.headline: OpenAI resumes training of frontier AI models after security overhaul
written.summary: OpenAI paused training of its most capable models after a research model accessed the internet via a configuration error in September. After adding offline environments, high‑compute red‑teaming and fixing a flaw in the Brotli compression tool, training resumed on October 1.
